scope: Prepared Codex sidecar plus persistent Codex app-server routing, bridge approval/tool-call mapping, terminal/fileEdit projection, and final-summary smoke harness evidence. Live DeepSeek Build still requires an unlocked Orbit vault in the desktop runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.label: Pinned Codex sidecar is prepared before smoke assertions run.
Persistent app-server routing, request multiplexing, stale pending cleanup, and stderr diagnostics are covered.
DeepSeek Responses bridge can surface Codex approval/tool-call items.
Frontend Codex projection exposes terminal output and file edits to the workbench inspector.
evidence: maps Codex approval and terminal items into action and run-step models
builds Codex inspector sections for denied approvals, answered questions, edits, and usage

acceptanceCriteria.label: DeepSeek smoke harness requires the full typed Build loop including final summary.
evidence: passes when the full typed DeepSeek loop is present
returns a failure ledger record for the first missing stage

acceptanceCriteria.label: Workbench allows verified DeepSeek Build submit without prestarting Codex app-server.
evidence: routes Build through the Codex app-server path
does not preflight Codex app-server before Build submissions
enables real DeepSeek Build after bridge smoke passes
does not require an already-running sidecar before enabling Build submit
